newsitem.title: FRANCE: French unemployment falls for third month - radio.
newsitem.headline: French unemployment falls for third month - radio.

text.p: French unemployment dropped in April, the third consecutive monthly decline, French RTL radio reported on Monday, without giving precise figures.
"The figures are out and unemployment has fallen for the third month in a row," the radio said. Official April unemployment figures were due to be released at 0645 GMT.

Unemployment was perhaps the biggest issue in French parliamentary elections, which concluded on Sunday with an upset win by the Socialist-led left as voters lashed out at the ruling centre-right for failing to lower joblessness.
In February and March, unemployment dipped slightly, but the rate was still 12.8 percent, the highest among the Group of Seven rich nations and a post war record for France.
